Summary:
- Enterprise e-discovery shop focused on regulated corporate investigations and compliance requests.
- Looking for private/VPC deployment with full control plane on customer network.
- Primary goal: fast, auditable RAG for 1M-120M docs (legal briefs, contracts, discovery bates sets).

POC requirements / technical constraints:
- Indexing target: incremental build to ~120M documents (~40-60 TB compressed). Will start with 10M sample for POC.
- Retrieval model: hybrid ANN (IVF/HNSW) -> cross-encoder reranker for top-50 candidates. Require support for cross-encoder hosting (GPU) in same VPC.
- Latency SLO: p95 end-to-end (retrieval + rerank + generation) <= 350ms for short queries; prefer ~250ms.
- Throughput: baseline 50 QPS, peak 200 QPS (burst to 400 for heavy discovery windows).
- Cost target: aiming for <$0.01/query end-to-end for steady state; POC cost tolerance higher.
- Analytics: token-level cost breakdown and per-route latency traces required.
- Retention: content retention policies vary by matter; audit logs must be retained 7+ years, immutable exportable logs for legal hold.
- Security: SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, customer KMS/HSM support for model artifacts and logs, SOC2 evidence for runtime.
